## Board of Library Trustees Meeting Minutes

**Wednesday, September 9, 2026, at 3:00 PM**

The meeting on September 9, 2026, was called to order at 3:00 PM by Joanne Geneva.

Present:

Voting Members:
- Joanne Geneva – Chair
- Peggy Blume – Secretary
- Sharon McCann-Kling – Member At Large

Non-Voting Members:
- Jim McQueen – Library Director
- Deb Griffin- Youth Services Librarian

The Trustees reviewed the minutes from the meeting held on August 12, 2026. Sharon made a motion to accept the minutes. Joanne seconded the motion. The motion passed unanimously.

## Sutton Free Public Library
## Youth Services Librarian Report
**Meeting: September 9, 2026**

### Programming:

For the month of September, we have 7 activities on the calendar with some activities repeating throughout the month. We have the return of Teen Dungeons & Dragons which is going to be meeting twice a month through December with a slightly different start time of 3:30. We've started to think about the upcoming Boo Bash, it now appears on our calendar (though the times on the listing may change.) We have a date (a Tuesday evening) for our Dinovember collaboration with the Millbury Public Library on the calendar, more information is coming soon. I'm starting a new Teen Volunteer Info Session in September as a way to revamp the teen volunteer system. I'll be able to give them an idea of what the needs are and possible opportunities the library has for them. We will still use the volunteer sign up through the calendar, but this will help streamline the process. I'm also in the process of incorporating more tween and teen friendly activities into the calendar. I will be creating a Teen Advisory group now that school is back in session and hope to use them as a place to discuss ideas that I have (such as a financial literacy workshop) and to hear what they would like to see at the library. Our This or That question continues to be popular. At the last meeting I mentioned that the question was Baby Shark vs Bruce from Finding Nemo. Bruce won with 121 votes to Baby Shark's 46! The currently posted question is crayons vs pencils. Lastly, a fun new item - we changed our "I got my library card today" stickers for our new library card applicants. Previously we had an Incredibles character as the image and now we have a sticker featuring Freckles the library giraffe!

### Collection Development:

Weeding of Juvenile boardbooks or Juvenile biographies are complete. I am currently working on Juvenile non fiction.

[Signature: Peggy Blume]

### Meetings:
- Sept 14: Friends meeting
- Sept 18: I've created a "Teen Volunteer Info Session" and will be meeting with a small group of teens that are interested in volunteering at the library. I will be able to go over the specifics of being a volunteer and hope to enlist them with some fun stuff to come.

***Joanne asked if kids needed to register for the Teen Volunteer Info Session. Deb said yes. Peggy asked how the program was being promoted. Deb responded through the website. Joanne asked about advisory group participants. Deb said she would approach the National Honor Society at the high school for interested teens.***

### Other:
- To Do: begin professional development through Massachusetts Library System learning pathways
- To Do: add to Tween and Teen programming
- Continued work using social media to promote our programs and events
- To Do: the reorganization of the cabinets in the Meeting Room
- To Do: cleaning out the back closet in hopes to use space more efficiently
- To Do: meet with the elementary level Librarians in the Sutton Public Schools
- Continued investigation and communication with various facilitators about scheduling upcoming programs/activities.

## Sutton Free Public Library
## Director's Report
**September 2026**

### Adult Programming:

Please see attached report for August 2026 program statistics. Adult programs scheduled for September include: Adult Coloring Club, Board Game Night, afternoon and evening book groups, Cribbage Club, Knots and Thoughts Fiber Club, Milk Jug Sowing, Sci-Fi and Fantasy Book Group, Steady and Strong Yoga, and Writing Group.

### FY 2027 State Aid:

The Annual Report Information Survey (ARIS) was completed and submitted in August. The Financial Report and Compliance Form are due October 2. I'm finished entering data into the Financial Report except for a couple of figures that come from the Town. It's my goal to complete and submit the report no later than September 10 so that Joanne can sign the Compliance Form by the end of the week.

### FY 2026 Town of Sutton Annual Report:

I've begun working on the library's annual report to the Town of Sutton for FY 2026. While the report won't be due until February, it's easier to gather some of the data while it's fresh, soon after the fiscal year has closed.

### Meetings and Training:
- State Aid Financial Report Workshop on August 7
- Blackstone Valley library directors' luncheon on August 26
- Town of Sutton monthly department heads' meeting on September 2
- Meeting with OverDrive rep on September 8
- Friends of the Library meeting on September 14
- CW MARS Users Council meeting on September 22

***Jim told the Board that the meeting with the OverDrive rep was very insightful and he has learned valuable information about OverDrive that will benefit library patrons.***

### Closings:

The library was closed Monday, September 7, for Labor Day and will be closed Monday, October 12, for Columbus Day.

***Jim discussed the budget. Joanne asked how much of the materials budget was funded by the town and State aid. Jim said he would need to calculate the percentages and let the Board know.***

***Jim gave the Board an update on the Strategic Plan. The focus groups held on September 1 were discussed. Joanne was very appreciative to all those who participated. She said it was very helpful hearing from a good cross section of the community what they wanted from library.***

***Sharon asked if ten participants was a good number to hear from. Jim said it was sufficient and the smaller group size gave everyone a chance to speak.***

***Sharon asked when the report would be available. Joanne relied hopefully early October.***

***Joanne made a motion to adjourn the meeting at 3:42. Sharon seconded the motion. The motion passed unanimously.***

***The next meeting of The Library Board of Trustees will be held October 7 at 3 PM.***
